ratios.facility: Credit Agreement ($100 million senior secured revolving credit facility)
ratios.quote: The Company’s loan covenants under the Credit Agreement require the Company to maintain a senior net leverage ratio not to exceed 3.50 to 1.00, which is to be tested quarterly on a trailing twelve-month basis.

ratios.facility: Credit Agreement ($100 million senior secured revolving credit facility)
ratios.quote: In addition, the Company is required to maintain an interest coverage ratio not less than 3.00 to 1.00 .

parsed.notes: The filing gives only the covenant limits and says the Company was in compliance as of October 3, 2026. It does not disclose actual ratio values. The senior net leverage ratio also sets the SOFR margin (1.375%–2.125%); that pricing use is not reported separately. The Credit Agreement is secured, so senior net leverage is mapped to secured_net_leverage.
